atoms.text: Tamani hat ihrem E-Mail-Freund Jesse eine Mail über das Leben in Indien geschickt, um ihm bei einer Präsentation über Indien zu helfen.

atoms.sound: ssml: Hey Jesse, it is so nice to hear from you. Here are some facts about India that you can use for your presentation. <break time='500ms'/>India has an area of around 3.3 million square kilometres and is the most populated country in the world, with 1.4 billion inhabitants.

ssml: Our capital city is New Delhi, but India has over 50 megacities. These are cities with more than 10 million inhabitants, like the city where I am from: <break time='200ms'/>Mumbai.<break time='500ms'/> India is a very multilingual and diverse country. There are hundreds of different languages, with Hindi being the most widely spoken.

b: ++Megacities are cities in which more than 10 million inhabitants live.
Megacities are cities with an area bigger than 100km².
Megacities are cities in which more than 5 million inhabitants live.

atoms.a: In which city does Tamani live?
Which city is India's capital city?

atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='700ms'/>Religion plays a very important role in our lives. Most Indians, like my family, are Hindu. <break time='700ms'/> I really like that so many people visit India every year to experience our vibrant culture and culinary. However, there are some problematic aspects our country still hast to face.

ssml: Even though there has been economic growth in the last few years, the majority lives in poverty. Another thing making me sad is that many girls don't have the privilege of attending school. While I am lucky to grow up in the city with access to education, this is not the case for all of my friends.

ssml: I am happy that you are interested in my life and country! Attached to this e-mail you will find a few photos for your presentation. All the best, Tamani. <break time='1000ms'/> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>Klicke auf den Anhang, um dir die Bilder anzusehen.</voice>
atoms.text: Tippe auf den Anhang, um dir die Bilder anzusehen.
Um die anderen Bilder zu sehen, tippe auf den Pfeil nach rechts.

instruction.text: Vervollständige Jesse's Plakat, indem du die fehlenden Begriffe und Bilder an die richtige Stelle ziehst.
